department: Department of Biological Sciences, College of Sciences

deadline.value: The Graduate School lists a March 15, 2027 Fall deadline (Spring: October 15; Summer: May 1); departmental review for Fall begins February 1, 2027 and continues until positions are filled (late applications accepted up to July 1 domestic / May 19 international, pending availability).
deadline.quote: Integrative Biology, Ph.D. | College of Sciences | *Also see Biological Sciences | Contact | Dr. Bernard Rees | [email protected] | Application Deadline | Spring Admission: October 15 | Summer Admission: May 1 | Fall Admission: March 15

also.quote: For fall admission, the review of applicants begins on February 1 and continues until all positions are filled. For spring admission, applications must be received by October 1.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Biology: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty members in their area of interest, though a pre-admission advisor commitment is not required: admitted Ph.D. students are assigned an interim advisor and select a research advisor during their first year.
supervisor.quote: they are strongly encouraged to contact faculty members in their area of interest.

also.quote: All students admitted to the doctoral program will be assigned an interim advisor. During the first year in the program, the student will select a research advisor (who may be the same as the interim advisor) and assemble an advisory committee.

funding.value: The department endeavors to provide stipend and tuition support (via teaching assistantships, research assistantships, scholarships, or fellowships) to all accepted students.
funding.quote: The department endeavors to provide stipend and tuition support to all accepted students. The most common form of support is a graduate assistantship, for either teaching or research duties performed in the department.

also.quote: The Department strives to support all students admitted into the MS and PhD program by teaching assistantships, research assistantships, scholarships, or fellowships.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter directly with an accredited baccalaureate degree (3.0+ GPA on a 4.0 scale); the Ph.D. requires a minimum of 60 semester hours beyond the baccalaureate degree.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree from an accredited university or college. | A grade point average of at least 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale).

also.quote: Doctoral students are required to complete a minimum of 60 semester hours beyond the baccalaureate degree.

notes: Requires 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, and CV/resume. Louisiana Board of Regents (BoR) four-year fellowships require U.S. citizenship, 3.5+ GPA, and GRE V+Q above the 70th percentile.
name: Integrative Biology
